# Imagemagick

> [!WARNING]
> This mod is deprecated: The letsencrypt image was renamed swag; use the swag mods.

This mod adds imagemagick and the php7 imagick module to nginx/letsencrypt, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `letsencrypt` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:letsencrypt-imagemagick
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:letsencrypt-imagemagick|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/letsencrypt-imagemagick/
